english.text: I would have thee to understand this, and would tell thee before all that sit here, and before the ancients of my people. If thou wilt take possession of it by the right of kindred: buy it, and possess it: but if it please thee not, tell me so, that I may know what I have to do. For there is no near kinsman besides thee, who art first, and me, who am second. But he answered: I will buy the field.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's a hot sunny blue-sky day with a little breeze so that I can flap my arms through it, this 1st day of July of 2025, Canada Day. Some people are wearing red. I ventured to Tim Hortons café for drinks and snacks. On my way, I saw Bob and George, the Greek-Cypriot brothers, as they just attended the festivities in Steveston Village, Lulu Island. There was salmon, they said. They bicycled. It was "fun," they said. Bob is visiting from "olde" England, where he now resides. A Thai neighbour with his Filipina wife hosted a nice Canada Day party in their cozy shady garden. People were sitting, enjoying food—Thais and Filipinos, probably. There was Mass in the morning at the "Clam Temple," where attendants even sang "O Canada"!

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 jim4 jim4 haa6 jat6 ge3 cing4 long5 laam4 tin1，jau5 siu2 siu2 mei4 fung1，dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 paak3 paak3 bok3 tau4 cyun1 gwo3，ni1 go3 2025 nin4 7 jyut6 1 jat6，gaa1 naa4 daai6 jat6。jau5 di1 jan4 zoek3 gan2 hung4 sik1。ngo5 mou6 him2 heoi3 zo2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 je5 tung4 sik6 siu2 sik6。 tou4 zung1，ngo5 gin3 dou2 hei1 laap6 coi3 pou2 lou6 si1 hing1 dai6 Bob tung4 George , keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 si2 dai3 fu1 si1 deon6 cyun1 ceot1 zik6 zit3 jat6 wut6 dung6。 keoi5 dei6 waa6 jau5 saam1 man4 jyu2。Bob hai6 jau4 keoi5 ji4 gaa1 geoi1 zyu6 ge3「gau6」jing1 gaak3 laan4 lai4 taam3 fong2。jau5 go3 taai3 gwok3 leon4 geoi1 tung4 keoi5 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 lou5 po4 hai2 keoi5 dei6 syu1 sik1 ge3 jam1 loeng4 faa1 jyun2 dou6 geoi2 hang4 zo2 jat1 go3 hou2 zeng3 ge3 gaa1 naa4 daai6 jat6 paai3 deoi3，jan4 dei6 zo6 saai3 hai2 dou6，hoeng2 sau6 gan2 sik6 mat6 —— ho2 nang4 hai6 taai3 gwok3 jan4 tung4 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4，ziu1 zou2 hai2「gap3 lei4 miu2」jau5 nei4 saat3，fuk6 mou6 jyun4 sam6 zi3 coeng3 zo2「 O Canada 」！
text: 呢個係一個炎炎夏日嘅晴朗藍天，有少少微風，等我可以拍拍膊頭穿過，呢個 2025 年 7 月 1 日，加拿大日。有啲人着緊紅色。我冒險去咗 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳飲嘢同食小食。 途中，我見到希臘塞浦路斯兄弟 Bob 同 George , 佢哋啱啱喺露露島嘅史蒂夫斯頓村出席節日活動。 佢哋話有三文魚。Bob 係由佢而家居住嘅「舊」英格蘭嚟探訪。有個泰國鄰居同佢嘅菲律賓老婆喺佢哋舒適嘅陰涼花園度舉行咗一個好正嘅加拿大日派對，人哋坐晒喺度，享受緊食物 —— 可能係泰國人同菲律賓人，朝早喺「蛤蜊廟」有彌撒，服務員甚至唱咗「 O Canada 」！
